attributes.name: Druva - Repeated Failed Administrator Logins
attributes.description: Detects repeated failed Druva administrator login attempts originating from the same source IP address. Multiple authentication failures within a short period may indicate brute-force attacks, password spraying, credential stuffing, or an attempt to compromise an administrator account.
author: Druva

meta.customer_usecase: Detects repeated failed Druva administrator login attempts originating from the same source IP address. Multiple authentication failures within a short period may indicate brute-force attacks, password spraying, credential stuffing, or an attempt to compromise an administrator account.

attributes.query:
druva.feature:"Admin Event"
and druva.event_type:"Admin Login"
and (
    event.outcome:"failure"
    or event.outcome:"failure"
)
